Hi everyone! 

I’m about to give birth and have a few questions about registering the baby with Bituach Leumi & Misrad HaPnim:

How soon after birth can we start the paperwork? Is the registration done at MH itself, or can it be done directly at the hospital’s MH office? And how soon can we get the baby’s ID number/passport to register him for Kupat Holim?

Would really appreciate hearing your experiences! Thank you! ❤️
